evidence: Has the Mining label, touches `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`, `src/interfaces/mining.h`, and `src/test/miner_tests.cpp`.
rationale: Provides block template memory accounting needed by Stratum v2 template providers to track transactions pinned outside the mempool. External clients holding templates indefinitely can keep evicted transactions alive without visibility, and this addition directly serves active downstream mining consumers.
